collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — DREAMS AND AMBITIONS (DRM-01..50, draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Big dreams, small dreams, secret dreams and silly ones: things villagers hope for, work toward, give up on, change their minds about, or simply enjoy imagining. Ambition is optional, and a dream that never comes true is not a sad ending.
Written in the style of the owner's own events. Edit anything and send it back; nothing ships until you approve.

collection.description: A villager secretly wishes a stream rock were known as theirs and finds a friend on it: ask them to shift over, or find another.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: There's a flat rock by the stream that (subject) sits on most evenings. Secretly, (subject.he/she) would love it if people called it "(subject)'s rock," the way there's a tree everyone calls after one of the old fishers. (subject.He/she) has never said this out loud. Today (friend) is sitting on it when (subject) arrives.

o1.name: Outcome A
o1.text: "Shove up," says (subject), and sits down too. They watch the stream. After a while (friend) says, "I always think of this as your rock." (subject) almost falls in. (subject.He/she) tries very hard to look like this is nothing. It is not nothing. It is the best thing anyone has said to (subject.him/her) all season.

o2.name: Outcome B
o2.text: (subject) walks a little further and sits on another rock. It's fine. It's a bit lumpy. The next evening, (subject.he/she) finds a small mark scratched on the first rock. It's (subject.his/her) name, in a child's handwriting. Nobody admits to doing it. (subject) sits on (subject.his/her) rock every evening after that.
